matches.note: Round 3 of the best-of-seven; Jackson leads 3-0.

Frank Scarpo slides on brass knuckles and knocks Chavez out for the ten count.

The OSF World Heavyweight Championship, with Inphino Blitz as special referee; Tempest retains and Blitz hits the Inphinite Reverb on the title belt afterward.

name: Battered, Broken, and Bruised (B3)

date.source: OSF's president reviews the pay-per-view in a column dated 7 October 2003; his review of the 2 October Assault already calls it past, so it was held before 2 October 2003.

matches.note: Review item 6: a draw by double knock-out after a Spinebuster from Locke and a high DDT from Silver.
Review item 11: Jacques wins with a Death Valley Driver.
Review item 13, the three-way bra and panties match Inphino Blitz orders for the three women in item 10: 'Mina won.'
Review item 16: Agent X's speed and kicks against Olf's strength; X loses.
Review item 20: a two-out-of-three falls match; Lillith takes the first fall and Yebanka the last two.
Review item 23: Holy Underground beats DaVatta Inc.
Review item 26: the rematch; Jacques wins again.
Review item 27: Register wins after chalk is thrown in Stewart's eyes; the review expects Stewart to get a rematch for 'that belt'.
Review item 30: the OSF World Champion Blitz, helped by the Miyabi Missionaries, lands the Inphinite knockout kick on Kenyatta Jackson.

notes: Dated by its review: the president's column lists thirty items of the broadcast in order. The bra-and-panties match (item 13, won by Mina) and the hardcore brawl (item 29) are not structured because their opponents are not named.
